metadata.description: Reticle — a runtime UI evidence + action harness for Android and iOS apps, distributed as a Cursor plugin.

plugins.name: reticle
plugins.description: Runtime UI evidence + action harness for Android and iOS apps. Inspect the running app's view / accessibility / Compose-semantics / SwiftUI / WebView DOM tree, resolve precise CSS selectors and per-phrase tap regions, drive real input, capture action traces, and live-patch UI properties without rebuilding.
